result:
The six earlier visual findings are closed, and I found one capture-level discrepancy: the dry-run failure captures show "added 10" in past tense. I judged text frames only and ran nothing.

**findings**
1. Result screens wrap with a hanging indent. The full cause and every outcome line show at 80x24, 40x20 and 120x40. The long result in `pty-result-ascii-40x20` scrolls, with "Lines 1-11 of 126, PgDn for more" on the last row. Closed.
2. ASCII locale on the real renderer. The `pty-ascii-80x24`, `pty-result-ascii-*` and `pty-review-ascii-40x20` headers record `LC_ALL` and `LC_CTYPE` unset and `LANG=C`, and list `non-ASCII characters on the screen: []`. A grep over every `*ascii*` text capture found zero non-ASCII bytes. The UTF-8 pty frames still show `·`, as expected. Closed.
3. Review keys readable. At 40x20 and 80x24, `review`, `review-scrolled` and `review-end` cover every line. The scroll indicator is "Lines a-b of n", and PgUp/PgDn appears in the hint only when the screen scrolls. At 120x40 everything fits. No `…` appears in any capture. Closed.
4. Path wrapping. `focus-device-40x20` breaks the Xcode path after `/`, and the long result paths wrap at separators. Closed.
5. Failure next steps. `review-failed-*`, `apply-error-*` and `apply-failure-*` all state a recovery step. Closed.
6. Dry-run wording. `apply-success-dry-run-*`, `review-dry-run-*` and `pty-result-80x24` read as would-change ("would add", "nothing was written"). Closed, except for the capture below.

**Riding items.** The hint line names j/k. The unfocused fixed and disabled values use #a9b1d6 (`focus-device-80x24` row 05, `both-off-80x24`). "Esc close" is gone. Esc on review still cancels, with a reason given.

**Material, capture-level.** `apply-failure-dry-run-{80x24,40x20,120x40}` sit under "RESULT (DRY RUN)" but show `+ user settings ...: added 10` in past tense. They also say "Close T3 Code and run setup again" under a header that says "run the dry run again". The fixture in `scripts/capture-setup-tui.ts` should use the would-add wording. The real pipeline output in `pty-result-80x24` is correct, so I judge the product text fine and the fixture wrong.

**Preference (optional)**
`review-dry-run-end-40x20` stops at "Lines 17-25 of 28", so its name overstates; `review-end-40x20` does reach the end.
The dry-run heading "REVIEW (DRY RUN: WOULD CHANGE, NOTHING IS WRITTEN)" is wordy and wraps at 40 columns.
The "(dry run, nothing written)" suffix repeats the result header.

**No new regressions.** I found no other material discrepancy in the changed screens at the three sizes.
